name: good-ux
description: Frontend UX auditor and build-time guide. Three modes — scan (whole-repo audit), diff (current changes), and guide (applied while writing UI, offered when relevant work appears and entered only on acceptance) — covering loading/error/empty/success states, forms, graceful degradation, familiarity and complexity laws, accessibility, destructive-action guards, and dark-pattern detection. Reports findings first; applies fixes only on approval (--fix skips the gate; dark patterns are never auto-fixed).
